summary: Sam Altman announced the full release of GPT-5.5-Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model variant claiming state-of-the-art performance on the CyberGym benchmark, alongside 'Patch The Planet' and 'Codex Security' features intended to fix rather than just find security problems.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims a shift from detection to automated remediation of security problems, a new task capability for the model line.
mechanisms.quote: Patch The Planet and Codex Security will help solve security problems instead of just finding them.

mechanisms.reason: Automated fixing of security issues implies an agent acting on findings rather than a human reviewing them, though the post gives no scale or measurement.
mechanisms.quote: Codex Security will help solve security problems instead of just finding them.

practices.reason: A named, shipped model variant claims SOTA on a cybersecurity benchmark and adds remediation capability, worth evaluating for security tooling but unreplicated outside the lab's own claim.
practices.quote: The full version of GPT-5.5-Cyber is here; state of the art performance on CyberGym.

practices.reason: CyberGym is cited as the benchmark supporting the capability claim, which an engineering team could look into as a security-capability measurement standard.
